Brook Infant School and Nursery - Welcome to the Breakfast and After School Club
pageCache.text:
Our School
Welcome to the Breakfast and After School Club
Welcome to Brook Infant School Breakfast and After School Club!
We are a school led and managed club providing wraparound care before and after school for children from Aged Two (Nursery) through to Year Six (Junior school).
Bookings
You can make your booking for school aged children (Reception to Year 6) by visitingour school online booking system - https://brook.childcare-online-booking.co.uk/index.php
If you have a Nursery child please contact us at brookclubbookings@brookinfant.school as Nursery children are booked via a different system. Unfortunately, Nursery children are not included on the Childcare Booking System. Please can we ask you not to create them an account whilst they are in Nursery.
Please note that the brookclubbookings@brookinfant.school email address is not monitored on evenings or weekends, so for those last minute bookings, please always contact the School Office on 01293 886521 so that we can get back to you quickly about whether there is space for your child in club.
Nursery aged children in club
We are proud to be able to support our nursery families by offering nursery care, term time only (38 weeks of the year) from 07:30 to 18:00 with the support of our school breakfast and after school team. Please contact us at brookclubbookings@brookinfant.school for more information regarding your Nursery aged child joining Club. For any other Nursery related information please see our Nursery pages on our website or contact Brook Infant Nursery at nurseryadmin@brookinfant.school.
Breakfast Club
Our Breakfast Club runs from 07:30 to 08.30 every day, term time and there is a walking bus to Maidenbower Infant and Junior School. Children have a selection of different yummy breakfasts including toast, bread, crumpets and cereals as well as fresh fruit.
We have lots of resources out for the children to play with from Lego, construction, creative projects, colouring, puzzles, games, books and much more as well as lots of outside play.
After School Club
Our After School Club runs every day from 15:00 through to 18:00.
Children are collected on the walking bus from Maidenbower Infant School and Junior School.
Children are welcomed into the club with a drink and a snack. We have themed fun weeks and children have full access to the school grounds and play equipment as well as a range of creative tasks. Children spend a lot of time outside playing team games, sports such as tennis and football as well as enjoying the school playing field and equipment.
We also provide a hot school meal for those children who are staying until 18:00. This ranges from macaroni cheese, roast dinner, pizza, cheese and tomato pasta or chicken korma and all dinners come with bread, salad or vegetables and pudding - links to our daily menus are below. All the hot meals are cooked on site.
New to Club?
Please can all new parents and children (eg. never booked with the club before) contact us on brookclubbookings@brookinfant.school or call us on 01293 886521 before a booking is made so that we can chat to you about your child before they start with us. Thank you.

pageCache.text:
About Us
Behaviour and Relationship
Learning with Love and Laughter
Here at the Brook Infant School and Nursery we want every child to be successful in 'Learning with Love and Laughter'. We teach the children through our five core values how to show prosocial behaviours each day.
We are committed to having a therapeutic understanding of children’s behaviours. One of the therapeutically informed approaches adopted within West Sussex is Therapeutic Thinking advocated by Angela Wadham. We have undertaken the training program and are now developing this approach with a focus on positive relationships.
Please see our Behaviour and Relationship policy.
Behaviour and Relationships
How can you support at home?
Model for your child and help them to:
Show care to others
Respect everyone as a unique person
Allow everyone a voice
Think for themselves
listItems: Respect everyone as a unique person
